svg.title: Causal-Based Review & Practice of Dasuttara Sutta Dhammas

g.text: Causal-Based Review & Practice of Dasuttara Sutta Dhammas
1. Laying the Foundation: Fostering Conditions for Growth
Live with Heedfulness as a governing principle
- Four wheels (e.g., civilized land, directing self rightly)
- Five factors for exertion (e.g., conviction, persistence)
- Ten qualities creating a protector (e.g., virtue, good friends)
These are the initial conditions that facilitate practice.
2. Cultivating the Path: Developing Skillful Qualities
- Six classes of craving & types of disrespect
- Nine dhammas rooted in craving & grounds for hatred
- Ten forms of wrongness & unskillful actions
This systematic abandoning clears the mind and path.
Engage in Self-Correction & Abandon Harmful States
- Four establishings of mindfulness (direct path to unbinding)
- Noble Eightfold Path (way to cessation of effluents)
- Seven Factors for Awakening (leads to clear knowing & release)
This continuous cultivation reinforces wholesome states.
Actively Develop & Make Skillful Qualities Arise
- Five clinging-aggregates (seeing their origination/cessation leads to release)
This leads to discernment of reality.
Comprehend the Nature of Conditioned Phenomena
(fundamental to holy life, leads to unbinding)
Experiential knowledge is key for liberation.
*(SDK for Sixes & Sevens not explicitly detailed in provided source)*
Directly Know the Core Truths & Their Cessation
- Six properties that are means of escape
- Eight inopportune situations for holy life
These require deep insight and sustained practice.
Four Fruits of the Contemplative Life
- Five Dhamma Aggregates (virtue, concentration, discernment, release, knowledge & vision of release)
- Seven Strengths of one whose effluents are ended
- Ten Qualities of One Beyond Training
These are the ultimate goals of the path.
Realize the Fruits of the Holy Life
